narrative.details:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
narrative.objectives: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.Thank you, champion. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
narrative.requestItemsText: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
